name: Spices, Sauces & Kitchen Foundations
description: A practical collection of homemade seasoning blends, mustards, condiments, gravies, dipping sauces, and versatile cooking foundations designed to connect recipes across the kitchen.

recipes.name: Creole-Style All-Purpose Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.
Whisk thoroughly, breaking up any clumps.
Transfer to an airtight spice jar and label with the date.
Use about 1–2 teaspoons per pound of meat or to taste on vegetables, potatoes, eggs, rice, and soups.
recipes.description: A bold, savory blend of paprika, garlic, herbs, and pepper for meats, vegetables, rice, and Southern-style dishes.
recipes.notes: This is a homemade Creole-style blend, not an exact duplicate of any commercial seasoning. Reduce the salt for more control at the stove.

recipes.name: Classic Italian Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and crush lightly between your fingers to even out the texture.
Store in an airtight spice jar away from heat and light.
Use 1–2 teaspoons in sauces, marinades, soups, roasted vegetables, or per pound of meat.
recipes.description: A balanced salt-free blend of oregano, basil, thyme, rosemary, parsley, and marjoram.

recipes.name: Ranch Seasoning Mix
instructions: Whisk all ingredients until evenly combined.
Store in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place according to the storage guidance on the buttermilk powder.
Use about 3 tablespoons in place of one standard packet of ranch seasoning.
For dressing, whisk 3 tablespoons seasoning with 1 cup mayonnaise and 1 cup buttermilk, then chill before serving.
recipes.description: A tangy herb seasoning for ranch dressing, dips, potatoes, chicken, crackers, and slow-cooker meals.

recipes.name: Greek-Style Citrus Herb Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and crush lightly with the back of a spoon or a mortar and pestle.
Transfer to an airtight jar and shake before each use.
Use 1–2 teaspoons per pound of chicken, beef, pork, fish, potatoes, or vegetables.
For a quick marinade, combine 1 tablespoon seasoning with 3 tablespoons olive oil and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
recipes.description: A savory Greek-inspired blend of herbs, garlic, orange peel, tomato, and gentle red-pepper warmth.
recipes.notes: Inspired by the ingredient profile shown on the commercial label; this is an original homemade approximation, not an exact duplicate. Oil is added only when using the blend so it remains shelf-stable.

recipes.name: Everyday Taco Seasoning
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together and store in an airtight jar.
Use 2½–3 tablespoons per pound of ground meat.
After browning the meat, add the seasoning with ⅔ cup water and simmer until the sauce coats the meat.
recipes.description: A dependable blend of chili, cumin, paprika, garlic, and oregano for tacos, rice bowls, and casseroles.

recipes.name: Fajita Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight spice jar.
Use about 2 tablespoons per pound of meat or vegetables.
For a marinade, combine 2 tablespoons seasoning with 2 tablespoons oil and 2 tablespoons lime juice.
recipes.description: A smoky, citrus-friendly seasoning for sliced chicken, steak, shrimp, peppers, and onions.

recipes.name: Hearty Chili Seasoning
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together and store in an airtight jar.
Use 3–4 tablespoons for a family-size pot made with about 2 pounds of meat and 28–30 ounces of tomatoes.
Add more near the end of cooking only after tasting.
recipes.description: A robust seasoning blend for beef, turkey, bean, or vegetable chili with adjustable heat.

recipes.name: Classic Poultry Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and crush to a fine, even texture.
Store in an airtight jar away from heat and light.
Use 1–2 teaspoons per pound of poultry or 1–2 teaspoons in gravy and bread dressing.
recipes.description: A fragrant salt-free blend of sage, thyme, marjoram, rosemary, and black pepper for poultry, gravy, and dressing.

recipes.name: Steakhouse Garlic-Pepper Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight jar.
Pat meat dry, lightly oil it, and season with about 1–1½ teaspoons per pound.
Allow seasoned steaks to stand for 20–30 minutes before cooking when practical.
recipes.description: A coarse, savory blend of salt, cracked pepper, garlic, onion, and herbs for steaks and roasted beef.

recipes.name: Savory Burger Seasoning
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together and store in an airtight jar.
Use about 1 teaspoon per pound of ground meat, or season the outside of formed patties just before cooking.
Avoid overmixing seasoning into ground meat so burgers remain tender.
recipes.description: A balanced garlic, onion, paprika, and pepper blend for burgers, meatloaf, and hamburger steak.

recipes.name: Homemade Lemon-Pepper Seasoning
instructions: Make sure the lemon zest is completely dry before mixing.
Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight jar.
Use on chicken, fish, vegetables, potatoes, pasta, or rice.
recipes.description: A bright salt-controlled blend of dried lemon zest, cracked pepper, garlic, and onion.

recipes.name: Garlic-Herb All-Purpose Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight jar.
Use 1–2 teaspoons per pound of meat or to taste on vegetables, potatoes, eggs, and bread.
Add salt separately so each dish can be seasoned accurately.
recipes.description: A salt-free everyday blend of garlic, onion, parsley, basil, thyme, and black pepper.

recipes.name: Blackening Seasoning
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together and store in an airtight jar.
Lightly coat food with oil or melted butter, then apply about 1 tablespoon seasoning per pound.
Cook in a hot, well-ventilated skillet or on the grill until properly done.
recipes.description: A smoky, peppery blend for developing a deeply seasoned crust on fish, chicken, shrimp, pork, or vegetables.

recipes.name: Sweet-and-Smoky Rib Rub
instructions: Break up the brown sugar, then combine it thoroughly with the remaining ingredients.
Store in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place.
Apply about 2 tablespoons per pound of meat, pressing it onto all surfaces.
For best flavor, refrigerate the seasoned meat for at least 1 hour before cooking.
recipes.description: A brown-sugar dry rub with paprika, garlic, mustard, and gentle heat for pork ribs and other barbecue meats.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Pie Spice
instructions: Whisk all ingredients until evenly combined.
Store in an airtight spice jar away from heat and light.
Use according to the recipe, or begin with 1 teaspoon per 2 cups of batter, oatmeal, or drink base.
recipes.description: A warm baking blend of cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, allspice, and cloves for pies, oatmeal, breads, and drinks.

recipes.name: Homemade Ketchup
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together in a saucepan until smooth.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat.
Cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and glossy.
Cool completely, transfer to a clean jar, and refrigerate for up to 3 weeks.
recipes.description: A smooth tomato ketchup with balanced sweetness, vinegar tang, and warm pantry spices.

recipes.name: Quick Homemade Mayonnaise
instructions: Add the egg, mustard, lemon juice, salt, and oil to a narrow jar just wider than the immersion blender head.
Place the blender flat on the bottom and blend without moving for 10–15 seconds, until mayonnaise forms at the base.
Slowly raise and tilt the blender to incorporate the remaining oil.
Refrigerate immediately in a clean covered jar and use within 4 days.
recipes.description: Thick, creamy mayonnaise made quickly with an immersion blender and a neutral-flavored oil.
recipes.notes: Use a pasteurized egg because the mayonnaise is not cooked. Keep refrigerated and discard if left at room temperature for more than 2 hours.

recipes.name: Classic Yellow Mustard
instructions: Whisk all ingredients in a small saucepan until smooth.
Bring to a very gentle simmer over low heat.
Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until thickened.
Cool, transfer to a clean jar, and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before using so the flavor mellows. Keep refrigerated for up to 1 month.
recipes.description: A smooth, bright, tangy mustard for sandwiches, hot dogs, dressings, and sauces.

recipes.name: Spicy Brown Mustard
instructions: Combine the mustard seeds, vinegar, and water in a jar. Cover and soak at room temperature for 24–48 hours.
Transfer to a blender with the brown sugar, salt, horseradish, and allspice, if using.
Blend to the desired texture, adding a little water if needed.
Transfer to a clean jar and refrigerate for 2–3 days before using. Keep refrigerated for up to 1 month.
recipes.description: A coarse, assertive mustard with brown mustard seed, vinegar, and a touch of horseradish warmth.

recipes.name: Creamy Honey Mustard Sauce

ingredients.item: apple cider vinegar or lemon juice

instructions: Whisk all ingredients until completely smooth.
Taste and adjust the balance with additional honey or mustard if desired.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Store refrigerated for up to 1 week.
recipes.description: A creamy sweet-tangy sauce for chicken, sandwiches, salads, salmon, and roasted vegetables.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken-Finger Dipping Sauce
instructions: Whisk all ingredients until smooth and evenly colored.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours; overnight gives the best flavor.
Stir before serving and keep refrigerated for up to 1 week.
recipes.description: A peppery, tangy mayonnaise-and-ketchup dipping sauce for chicken, fries, burgers, and sandwiches.
recipes.notes: This noncommercial family dipping sauce is designed for the same general use as popular restaurant chicken sauces.

recipes.name: Creamy Burger Sauce
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together until smooth.
Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Use on burgers, sandwiches, wraps, or as a fry dip. Refrigerate for up to 1 week.
recipes.description: A tangy, lightly sweet burger sauce with pickle relish, mustard, and a hint of smoked paprika.

recipes.name: Red Enchilada Sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and oregano. Cook for 30 seconds.
Gradually whisk in the broth, then stir in the tomato sauce.
Simmer for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until smooth and lightly thickened.
Stir in the vinegar and salt. Refrigerate for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 3 months.
recipes.description: A smooth, savory red chile sauce for enchiladas, casseroles, rice, tacos, and braised meats.

recipes.name: Thin Restaurant-Style Peanut Sauce

ingredients.item: crushed red pepper or chili sauce

instructions: Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and chili, if using.
Gradually whisk in hot water or broth until the sauce reaches a thin, pourable consistency.
Taste and adjust with additional vinegar, soy sauce, or honey.
Serve warm or at room temperature. Refrigerate for up to 1 week and thin again after chilling.
recipes.description: A smooth, savory peanut sauce designed to drizzle, dip, or stir into hot-pot bowls, noodles, and vegetables.

recipes.name: Sweet-Savory Gochujang Sauce
instructions: Whisk the gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and 1 tablespoon water.
Add more water as needed for the intended use.
Stir in sesame seeds, if using.
Use as a dipping sauce, drizzle, glaze, or stir-fry sauce. Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
recipes.description: A balanced Korean-inspired sauce combining fermented chile paste with soy, vinegar, honey, garlic, ginger, and sesame.

recipes.name: Everyday Teriyaki Sauce
instructions: Combine the soy sauce, ½ cup water, brown sugar, honey, vinegar, garlic, and ginger in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 3 minutes.
Whisk the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water. Stir the slurry into the sauce.
Simmer for 1–2 minutes, until glossy and thickened.
Cool and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
recipes.description: A glossy sweet-savory soy and ginger sauce for chicken, beef, salmon, vegetables, and rice bowls.

recipes.name: Creamy Parmesan Alfredo Sauce
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in the cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 3–4 minutes; do not boil hard.
Reduce the heat to low and gradually whisk in the Parmesan until melted and smooth.
Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, if using. Serve immediately or thin with pasta water as needed.
recipes.description: A standalone garlic-Parmesan cream sauce for pasta, chicken, vegetables, casseroles, and pizza.

recipes.name: Homemade Brown Gravy
instructions: Melt the butter or drippings in a saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 3–5 minutes, until medium brown and nutty-smelling.
Gradually whisk in the broth, then add Worcestershire, onion powder, garlic powder, and pepper.
Simmer for 5–8 minutes, whisking often, until smooth and thickened.
Taste before adding salt. Serve hot.
recipes.description: A smooth, deeply savory beef gravy for mashed potatoes, hamburger steak, meatloaf, and roasted meats.

recipes.name: Homemade Chicken Gravy
instructions: Melt the butter or drippings in a saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 2–3 minutes without allowing it to become dark.
Gradually whisk in the broth. Add the poultry seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder, and pepper.
Simmer for 5–8 minutes, whisking often, until smooth and thickened.
Taste before adding salt and serve hot.
recipes.description: A silky chicken gravy with butter, broth, herbs, and gentle poultry seasoning.

recipes.name: Garlic-Herb Butter Sauce
instructions: Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1–2 minutes, until fragrant but not browned.
Remove from the heat and stir in the parsley, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and red pepper, if using.
Use immediately as a finishing sauce, dipping sauce, or cooking base.
recipes.description: A quick melted-butter sauce with garlic, parsley, and lemon for bread, pasta, seafood, meat, and vegetables.
